hypotheses.R0_margin_equals_top1_minus_runnerup: Per-channel and aggregate margin effects equal top1-minus-runner-up effects to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.R1_top1_logit_path_is_native_sparse: A frozen 128-channel top1-logit bank retains at least 0.90 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R2_runnerup_logit_path_is_native_sparse: A frozen 128-channel runner-up-logit bank retains at least 0.90 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R3_margin_density_is_created_by_combinin: Direct margin K90 is at least four times the larger individual-logit K90 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R4_union_of_logit_banks_compresses_margi: The union of the top 128 channels for each individual logit retains at least 0.90 of the margin on every corpus.
hypotheses.R5_logit_banks_are_distinct: Top1 and runner-up top-128 discovery banks overlap in fewer than 96 channels.
hypotheses.R6_margin_cancellation_exceeds_individua: Median margin absolute projection mass exceeds each individual-logit mass by at least 1.0 on every corpus.
